note: Flavour for the Cain's-notes bestiary (TASK-158). name is the in-game monster name compared case-insensitively with the goals kill events and with monstats. family is the only thing a locked silhouette shows. tipTag: S secondary (the SME's veteran memory, docs/research/class-early-game.md and fun-ideas.md), U unverified. Type, resists and the attack pattern come from the extracted game tables, never from this file.

kinds.name: Fallen
kinds.flavour: Small red imps with more courage than sense. They scatter when their leader falls.
kinds.drops: Gold and the odd potion; nothing special.
kinds.tip: Fight them in a corridor, not in the open; they run when the pack leader or a shaman dies.

kinds.name: Fallen Shaman
kinds.flavour: The one with the staff. It calls its dead back to their feet.
kinds.tip: Kill shamans first, or the pack never stays dead.

kinds.name: Carver
kinds.flavour: A Fallen that kept its spear and lost its manners.
kinds.tip: Hits harder than a Fallen; do not let a pack surround you.

kinds.name: Devilkin
kinds.flavour: Older and meaner kin of the Fallen, with a cruel staff of their own.
kinds.tip: Treat a pack as a shaman fight: kill the caster first.

kinds.name: Quill Rat
kinds.flavour: A rat with a coat of needles it is glad to throw at you.
kinds.tip: The needles chip life from a distance; close in quickly or step out of line.

kinds.name: Zombie
kinds.flavour: Slow, stubborn and not much to look at once you are close.
kinds.tip: Slow movers: keep your distance and use it.

kinds.name: Skeleton
kinds.flavour: Old bones that have not been told to lie down.
kinds.drops: Gold, sometimes a weapon or armour piece.
kinds.tip: Bones shrug off blades; fire and magic work better.

kinds.name: Returned
kinds.flavour: A skeleton with a grudge and a better shield.
kinds.tip: Archers among them shoot from range; get out of the line of fire.

kinds.name: Goatman
kinds.flavour: Tall, horned and out of the highlands.
kinds.tip: Hard hitters in a crowd; veterans meet them later than the Cold Plains.

kinds.name: Gargantuan Beast
kinds.flavour: Slow and huge, and it knows it.
kinds.tip: Slow to turn; do not stand toe to toe.
